newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent eyes lower levels after gasoline drops.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent eyes lower levels after gasoline drops.

text.p: September Brent futures were untraded on SIMEX at midday on Friday but were eyeing lower levels following a slump in U.S. gasoline futures.
September Brent was quoted at a wide $18.75/$19.00 per barrel on SIMEX, after the contract fell three cents to $18.94 per barrel in London overnight.
NYMEX September crude was last traded at $19.96 per barrel on ACCESS after-hours trading, down 14 cents from New York.
Brokers said the weaker tone followed the slump in August gasoline futures at the expiry in New York on Thursday.
Buying of the contract had supported the NYMEX complex and Brent crude for several weeks as players scrambled to get long amid tight U.S. supplies.

But on expiry Thursday, August gasoline settled 2.06 cents lower at 67.84 cents per gallon after speculators. September gasoline, which rose 0.04 cent on NYMEX to 62.80, fell back 0.20 on ACCESS to 62.60.
